name: 考勤月度统计
description: 官方“考勤统计”的数据源：按员工+周期汇总
statement: SELECT a.employee_no AS employee_no, a.employee_name AS employee_name, a.attend_period AS attend_period, SUM(a.should_days) AS should_days, SUM(a.actual_days) AS actual_days, SUM(a.late_count) AS late_count, SUM(a.early_count) AS early_count, SUM(a.absent_count) AS absent_count, SUM(a.leave_days) AS leave_days, SUM(a.overtime_hours) AS overtime_hours, SUM(a.travel_days) AS travel_days, e.dept AS dept, e.position AS position FROM hr_attend a LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.employee_no = a.employee_no GROUP BY a.employee_no, a.employee_name, a.attend_period, e.dept, e.position
sql: SELECT a.employee_no AS employee_no, a.employee_name AS employee_name, a.attend_period AS attend_period, SUM(a.should_days) AS should_days, SUM(a.actual_days) AS actual_days, SUM(a.late_count) AS late_count, SUM(a.early_count) AS early_count, SUM(a.absent_count) AS absent_count, SUM(a.leave_days) AS leave_days, SUM(a.overtime_hours) AS overtime_hours, SUM(a.travel_days) AS travel_days, e.dept AS dept, e.position AS position FROM hr_attend a LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.employee_no = a.employee_no GROUP BY a.employee_no, a.employee_name, a.attend_period, e.dept, e.position
